import pandas as pd

match = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2024) &
    (df['County'].astype(str).str.upper() == 'STATEWIDE') &
    (df['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated Cesarean Delivery')
]
result = float(match['Rate'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_medical_procedure_utilization_rates.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1')
hosp_2020 = df[(df['Year'] == 2020) & (df['Hospital'] == 'Sutter Davis Hospital')]
vbac_rate = hosp_2020[hosp_2020['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated VBAC']['Rate'].iloc[0]
cesarean_rate = hosp_2020[hosp_2020['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated Cesarean Delivery']['Rate'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if float(vbac_rate) > float(cesarean_rate) else 'no'
